title: Book Three · Chapter 71: The Warm Paper Bag
story:
On Saturday, Ronan finishes the short delivery before eleven.

The customer tries the coat, checks the sleeve, and thanks him. He takes the empty bag and walks toward home.

Near the library, a stall is selling hot sweet potatoes. Ronan checks the coins in his pocket. He has enough for one.

He chooses a large one and asks the man to cut it in half. The two pieces go into a paper bag.

Then Anna comes down the library steps with a book against her coat.

Ronan lifts the warm bag.

“Hungry?”

She looks at it and smiles.

“A little.”

They sit on a bench out of the wind. He offers the bag, and she takes one piece.

The yellow inside is too hot at first. Both wait before they bite.

“Work finished?” Anna asks.

“One coat. One sleeve checked.”

“Your work sounds very clear.”

“The school question last night wasn't.”

He tells her about the number with the question mark. Anna knows that example too. She had to start it again once.

“You too?” he asks.

“Yes. Don't look so surprised.”

He laughs. She takes a careful bite, then opens her borrowed book on the clean part of her bag.

There is another picture of people around a model. Ronan looks at the long table and the little walls.

“Still architecture?”

“Still.”

He nods. The word sounds familiar now, but the other city still feels far away.

“I don't know my work yet,” he says.

Anna closes the book so she can look at him.

“You made the class understand the light.”

“Kai made it work.”

“I know. You made us look at the right part.”

Ronan turns the warm potato in its paper. He remembers the noise from the chair and his own voice at the front.

“I like that part,” he says. “Talking to people.”

“And feeding them.”

She lifts the last bite. He laughs and finishes his own piece.

A little yellow potato sticks to one finger. Anna shows him before it reaches his coat. He wipes it on the paper.

“A narrow escape for the shirt,” she says.

Ronan looks down at the clean cuff. “It has had practice.”

They carry the empty paper to a bin. Anna needs to go home with her book. Ronan needs to return Mum's cloth bag.

For a few minutes, they walk together. He can hear the book's stiff cover tap against her coat.

At the crossing, Anna stops beside him. The wind lifts her hair, and she pushes it back with one hand.

Ronan waits with her until the road is clear. The warmth from the potato stays in his fingers all the way to West Lane.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sweet potato＝红薯；stiff＝硬挺的；cuff＝袖口；escape＝幸免、逃过（本章用于小玩笑）。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan有没有为了一起吃东西多接工作或动用全部存款？他买了多少？
2. Anna提到课堂展示时，认可的是Ronan哪项具体能力？这是否等于他已经确定职业？

## 读句子

**He offers the bag, and she takes one piece.**

拆开看：He / offers the bag, / and she takes one piece.

他／把纸袋递过去／她取了其中一半。
